message:
test(host): the punch test's root must be a folder; each run reserves its own new folder (keepalive-r2 FINDING r4, Codex codex_ka_punch_thread_src_r3.md T2-a T2-b)

T2-a (Codex reproduced: a plain FILE given as the root passed 9/9): after CreateDirectory "already exists" only the
link bit was read. Now the root must look up as a directory and no link, or the test refuses (exit 2) -- the sentinel
file stays.
T2-b: a PID-named cache pre-deleted in a root that may already exist proved no ownership (PIDs are reused). Now the run
makes a NEW folder of its own in the root (CreateDirectory fails on any existing name; retried under another), the
cache file lives there, nothing is deleted before the run, and after it only that file and this run's folder (not
recursive) go. Anything already in the root is left alone.

9/9 x3 in .claude/test-tmp/ka-punch with a foreign "host-agent.cache" placed there first: kept with its content; the
run folders gone. A plain file as the root: refused, kept. Product unchanged (6c3cb5a SOURCE OK).
